title: Garden and Thorn
author: Beatrix Delacroix
blurb: Dominic Delacroix, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
